Q5217.reason: Costco's confirmation was expressly conditional on a loading charge, so under UCC 2-207 it is a counteroffer and no contract formed from the writings.

Q6156.reason: The deposition is former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1): the engineer is unavailable, and the company had a prior opportunity and similar motive to examine him in the wrongful-termination suit.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK (2001) the Court held that applying state immunity did not violate Article 6 access-to-court rights, so the two were not in conflict.
